data.body_html:
Few experiences rival watching the sun dip into the Mediterranean from the deck of a private boat. An Estepona boat charter sunset cruise offers a romantic escape with stunning views of the Costa del Sol coastline. Whether you’re celebrating an anniversary, planning a proposal, or simply want a memorable evening, a sunset charter combines luxury, privacy, and natural beauty. With departures from nearby Puerto Banús, you can be on the water in minutes, sipping cava as the sky turns gold.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise from Estepona?

Estepona’s position on the western Costa del Sol gives you unobstructed views of the sunset over the sea. The nearby Sierra Bermeja and La Concha mountain provide a dramatic backdrop. Unlike crowded beach bars, a private boat offers intimacy and flexibility. You can anchor at a quiet cove like Cala del Faro or cruise past the luxury villas of the Golden Mile. The gentle evening breeze and the sound of waves make it a perfect setting for romance.

Best Boats for a Romantic Evening

Our fleet includes several options ideal for a sunset cruise. For a cosy two-hour trip, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) are excellent choices. Both are Tier A boats priced at €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive. If you want more space and a flybridge, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) offers panoramic sunset views. For a truly luxurious experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. All charters include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

What to Expect on a Sunset Charter

Your skipper will meet you at Puerto Banús, just a 10-minute drive from Estepona. After a safety briefing, you’ll cruise west towards the sunset. The typical route passes Marbella’s coastline, with stops at Cabopino or Cala Cortés for swimming if you wish. Onboard, you’ll find a selection of drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. The skipper can also recommend a spot to anchor and watch the sunset. Most charters last 2 to 4 hours, depending on your preference.

Romantic Extras to Make It Special

To elevate the evening, consider adding a private chef who can prepare a gourmet dinner onboard. Alternatively, we can arrange flowers, a personalised playlist, or a bottle of premium champagne. For proposals, we can coordinate with the skipper to time the moment perfectly as the sun sets. Simply let us know your requirements when booking, and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Best Time of Year for Sunset Cruises

The sunset season in Marbella runs from May to October, with the longest days in June and July. Sunset times range from 21:30 in midsummer to 20:00 in late September. Even in April and November, you can enjoy a sunset cruise, though temperatures are cooler. The sea is calmest in the evening, making for a smooth ride. Our boats are available year-round, weather permitting.
